entries.name: mcp__neatlogs__create_detection
entries.description: Create a detection in this project and start a 14-day backfill so it immediately scores recent traces. For regex / conditional types, run preview_detection FIRST and only create if it flags > 0 spans; classifier / pii are created directly. Needs a group_id from list_detection_groups (or create_detection_group).

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the dashboard.

group_id.description: UUID of the group this detection belongs to. Get one from list_detection_groups (or create_detection_group). Required.

type.description: Detection type. classifier: preset ML model (jailbreaking|nsfw|hate|refusals). regex: pattern match on input/output. conditional: field/operator rule tree. pii: entity detection.

config.description: Type-specific config. classifier: {classifier_slug:'jailbreaking'|'nsfw'|'hate'|'refusals'}. regex: {input_pattern?, output_pattern?, operator?='OR', case_sensitive?=false} (at least one pattern). conditional: {root:{type:'group', logic:'AND'|'OR', children:[...]}}. pii: {entities?:['EMAIL_ADDRESS','PHONE_NUMBER',...]} (omit = all).

description.description: Short description of what the detection flags.

run_on.description: Where the detection runs. Omit for per-trace. span_types required for frequency='span_type'; span_names required for frequency='span_name'.

entries.name: mcp__neatlogs__get_detection_capabilities
entries.description: Discover native detection config/code input schemas and authoring guidance, plus existing project monitoring. Hermes product mutations use a scoped service-account Public API authoring route; this tool grants no write permission. Prepare and inspect real-data preview before creating. Custom classifier training retains its own reviewed lifecycle.

entries.name: mcp__neatlogs__get_trace_context
entries.description: Get persisted trace context and processing status. Fetch by trace ID, one distinct candidate for a process-scoped verification marker, or the latest project trace after a timestamp. Optionally filter spans by type/name, select payload fields, and head-tail clip large text. For stable pagination, pass the returned context_revision with each next_offset until next_offset is null.

include_evaluations.description: Include a bounded evaluation/run first page (default true); use get_trace_evaluations to continue

created_after.description: Fetch the latest trace in this project after this ISO timestamp

verification_marker.description: Fetch a project trace candidate carrying this process-scoped runtime marker

candidate_offset.description: Zero-based distinct trace candidate for a process-scoped verification marker

span_types.description: Return only these span types. Matching is case-insensitive and aliases such as tool/tool_call are equivalent.

span_names.description: Return only spans whose names exactly match one of these values

fields.description: Optional span payload/code fields to return. Status, model, token counts, tool name, and tool arguments are always included.

max_chars_per_field.description: Retained Unicode characters per text field before head-and-tail clipping (default 2000)

context_revision.description: Revision returned by the first selective page; pass it unchanged on subsequent pages

entries.name: mcp__neatlogs__list_detections
entries.description: List all active detections enabled on this project. A detection is a rule (regex / classifier / conditional) that flags spans matching a pattern — e.g. Hallucination, Jailbreak Attempt, Task Failure, User Frustration. Use this to discover which `detection_name` values are valid for `get_detection_trend`, or to answer 'what is this project monitoring for?'

group_id.description: Optional group UUID to scope the listing (e.g. only Safety detections). Omit to list every active detection.

entries.name: mcp__neatlogs__preview_detection
entries.description: Dry-run a regex or conditional detection against recent traces without saving it. Returns total_count (how many spans it would flag) plus sample matches. ALWAYS call this before create_detection for regex / conditional types, and only create if total_count > 0.

type.description: Detection type to preview. Only regex and conditional are previewable; classifier and pii cannot be previewed — create those directly.

config.description: Type-specific config. regex: {input_pattern?, output_pattern?, operator?='OR', case_sensitive?=false} (at least one pattern). conditional: {root: {type:'group', logic:'AND'|'OR', children:[{type:'rule', field, operator, value}]}}.

run_on.description: Where the detection runs. Omit for per-trace.

timeframe_days.description: How many days back to scan (default backend-side).

entries.name: mcp__neatlogs__search_traces
entries.description: Search traces by free-text query with incident-loop summaries and optional field projection. Defaults to BM25 keyword search; pass mode=semantic for vector search.

mode.description: Search mode. keyword (default): BM25 over span text. semantic: vector cosine search (requires embedder service to be configured).

fields.description: Optional trace fields to return. trace_id is always returned; search results also retain score.

preview_chars.description: Maximum Unicode characters returned in each input/output preview (default 500, max 2000).

detection_name.description: Filter by detection signal name (e.g. hallucination, task_failure)

min_duration.description: Minimum total trace duration in ms

content.text:
T05b is done and committed as 377406b (not pushed). `uv run pytest -q` passes (200 passed, E0093). No model spend and no code changes.

- **Trace ids:** `docs/evidence/traces.md` now pairs 11 committed runs with trace ids, matching run start time to trace start within a few seconds. The all-counties run has one trace per county. It also says how to open a trace (`search_traces`, then `get_trace_context` with `limit` 5).
- **Recovery cases:** `docs/evidence/recovery.md` has the trace ids for the Scurry case and the Cottle resume. The 112935 run (cases 1 and 2) has none: the nearest close trace starts two minutes before that run.
- **Not found:** San Saba's trace in the all-counties run, the first part of run 135519, and every run after 13:58. No search result starts later than 13:58:22.
- **Spans quoted:** I quoted one from each of two traces (Panola run 130414, Cottle resume of 135519). Panola's image shows as `image 2614x194 sha256:3072e8ba0476`. Cottle's does not: it is a media record in state `failed` ("upload unavailable: backend_upload_contract_unavailable"). Some images in other traces show the same way.
- **Detection:** "Crossfoot slow haiku call (over 20 s)", id `ee3ce3bc-f2cc-44f6-aecb-387ebfdb3727`. It is conditional and flags an LLM span with latency over 20,000 ms and model `claude-haiku`. The preview matched one span, and the server answered "Detection created" with a 14-day backfill pending.
- **Why that kind:** I could not write the brief's first two choices. A `reread*` span has no output, and the repair call has no span of its own. So the match is a close-county planning call, not a page read, and the name says "haiku call" for that reason.
- **Not checked:** I did not re-read the detection with `list_detections` after creating it, so "active" is only the server's creation answer. I also did not identify which trace holds the matched span.
- **Refused:** search with `fields` and the `get_trace_context` options answered `not_enabled`.

The report is in `.prod-build/reports/T05b.md`, and the `hackathon.md` build log has a dated entry.
